{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicates)
print(f'Number of patients with duplicate entries: {duplicate_count}')

# Check sample_seq for each duplicate patient to identify which row to keep
# Keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_deduplicated = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify that patient_id is now unique
assert df_deduplicated['patient_id'].nunique() == len(df_deduplicated), "Deduplication failed: patient_id is not unique"

# Final number of unique patients
num_patients = len(df_deduplicated)
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_patients}')"}
